scope: Actual frozen ordinary video resolution with registered CoreResolutionIgnoreRule and DotIgnoreIgnoreRule, real files and ItemPersistenceService/EF SQLite. Version cases execute ResolveAlternateVersion and UpdateItemAsync; owned cases execute the RefreshMetadata/RefreshedOwnedItems wrapper, CreateItem and independent deletion. Records all original row/Data/file/cache/event projections, ignore-before-resolution, lookup bypass and wrong-type deletion order. Single-item provider saves, collection membership, saver/media-source/external file dispatch and ancestor namespace are controls. No complete resolver/scanner, MetadataService, network/symlink/concurrent cache or release acceptance.
